standard-dialogue.npc: Beware the Chambers of Xeric, adventurer.
These dungeons and the perils within them are unique. You will encounter both dangerous and mysterious creatures here.
Remember that you may be kicked out at any time - any items dropped on the ground will be lost inside.
Do not allow your curiosity to get the better of you.

standard-dialogue-claim-cape.player: Can I have a cape like yours?

standard-dialogue-claim-cape.npc: Of course, you have earned it.

steps.text: The Captain hands you a cape.
